lead: A closure that declares a return type and then only throws does not compile.
body: `fn(int $n): int => throw new LogicError('no')` is `E0401: expected int, found never`, while the same closure with no `: int` on it is accepted, so the same throwing step is fine in one attack file and refused in the next. Write that step as a static method declaring the return type and throwing in its body, and hand the closure a call to it.
